description: A Flask-based web application implementing a simple to-do list with user authentication, including signup, login, logout, item creation with due dates, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles user registration, adding new users with hashed passwords.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, verifying credentials and starting a session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the user session to log out.

methods.name: home
methods.description: Main page for viewing and adding to-do items, managing overdue status based on due dates.

methods.name: delete_item
methods.description: Deletes a specified to-do item based on checkbox selection.
